title: Monitoring Health
description: Prometheus watching itself: target health, scrape cost, TSDB growth, and the state of the 18 node_exporters.

options.content:
Whether the thing that watches everything else is itself working.

---

panels.title: Slowest scrape
panels.description: A scrape slower than its interval is a target about to start missing samples.

panels.title: TSDB on disk
panels.description: Compacted blocks only, so it lags the head block by up to two hours. Retention is 15 days.

options.content:
Every scrape endpoint, its health and what it costs.

---

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Sorted slowest first. `New series` climbing on every scrape is a cardinality leak — a label carrying something that changes each time.

panels.title: Scrape duration by job
panels.description: The slowest target in each job.

panels.title: Samples scraped by job
panels.description: Stacked, so the height is what one full scrape cycle costs.

options.content:
How the time series database is holding up.

---

panels.title: Compactions and truncations
panels.description: Both are routine housekeeping. Compactions failing, rather than running, is the thing worth noticing.

panels.title: Query duration
panels.description: p99 by stage. A slow eval stage is usually one dashboard asking for too much.

options.content:
The 18 node_exporters, and the things they quietly fail to collect.

---

panels.title: node_exporter fleet
panels.description: `Collectors erroring` is almost always hardware the host does not have — fibrechannel, infiniband, tape, IPVS. It is worth reading once to learn the baseline, not worth alerting on. `Version` is 1.9.0 fleet-wide because APT owns the binary.

defaults.noValue: No unit is in the failed state anywhere in the fleet.

panels.title: Textfile collector errors
panels.description: The TeamSpeak and SMART metrics arrive this way. An error here means a half-written file, so the metrics above it are stale rather than absent — which is the more dangerous failure.

panels.title: Pending package updates
panels.description: Only the Debian hosts run the APT collector; Rocky and the two hosts on an upstream binary are absent by design rather than up to date.

defaults.noValue: No host is reporting a pending update.
